name: Non-Invasive Leakage Assessment (ISO/IEC 17825)
description: Covers conformance-style side-channel leakage assessment of cryptographic modules using Test Vector Leakage Assessment (TVLA) and the Welch t-test methodology defined in ISO/IEC 17825. Includes fixed-vs-random and specific test design, measurement setup qualification and calibration (ISO/IEC 20085), statistical threshold interpretation and false-positive control, and reporting of results against the FIPS 140-3 non-invasive security requirements. Key-recovery attacks belong to HWSEC-SCA-DPA.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to leakage assessment methodology

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the purpose of leakage assessment and the statistics behind the Welch t-test
evidence: Can explain the difference between leakage detection (TVLA) and key-recovery attacks
Can describe fixed-vs-random and fixed-vs-fixed test designs and the significance threshold used in ISO/IEC 17825
Aware of how FIPS 140-3 references ISO/IEC 17825 for non-invasive security requirements

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Executes leakage assessment test campaigns from a prepared procedure under supervision
evidence: Acquires interleaved fixed and random trace sets following the test procedure
Computes first-order t-test statistics with provided tooling and plots results over time
Records acquisition parameters (sampling rate, bandwidth, trigger, trace count) in the test record
Repeats tests on independent data sets as required by the procedure

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently designs, qualifies and executes ISO/IEC 17825 leakage assessments
evidence: Qualifies the measurement setup (noise floor, bandwidth, synchronisation) and documents it against ISO/IEC 20085 calibration expectations
Selects test vectors, trace counts and statistical orders appropriate to the security level being assessed
Distinguishes genuine leakage from artefacts (misalignment, trigger leakage, environmental drift) and justifies verdicts
Produces leakage assessment reports stating pass/fail per test with full traceability to the standard

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Applies higher-order and multivariate assessment; reviews leakage reports; mentors team
evidence: Performs higher-order and multivariate t-tests for masked implementations and interprets their limitations
Correlates detected leakage with the implementation to inform targeted key-recovery attempts
Technically reviews leakage assessment reports for statistical soundness and measurement validity
Mentors analysts on test design, setup qualification and result interpretation

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognised authority on leakage assessment; defines lab methodology; contributes to standards
evidence: Defines the lab's leakage assessment methodology and measurement setup qualification procedure
Contributes to ISO/IEC 17825, ISO/IEC 20085 or related standardisation and guidance
Publishes research on leakage detection statistics or their limitations
Advises validation bodies and vendors on interpretation of non-invasive test results

assessment_methods.description: Qualify a provided measurement setup and run a fixed-vs-random TVLA campaign on a training target with a known leaking and a protected configuration, reporting the verdict for each with supporting statistics
Review a leakage assessment report for correct test design, documented setup qualification, sound handling of false positives and verdicts traceable to ISO/IEC 17825

equipment: High-resolution oscilloscope or SCA acquisition platform meeting ISO/IEC 20085 requirements
Low-noise amplifier and current probe for power measurement
Near-field EM probes for EM-channel assessment
